worktreeOnboarding.title: What is a Worktree?
worktreeOnboarding.description: Worktrees create a git branch in an isolated directory, separate from your main repository. This gives you a safe place to make changes without affecting the rest of your code.
worktreeOnboarding.safeDescription: AI changes stay in a separate branch
worktreeOnboarding.reviewDescription: Review and merge changes when ready

agentMode.title: Agent Mode
agentMode.body: A focused coding agent management interface. Manage many running AI agent sessions, track their execution, control their commits and organize them with a Kanban board. Pick your agent, give instructions, and the AI agent will write code, run commands, and make changes across your project.

filesMode.title: Files Mode
filesMode.body: Browse and edit your project files. Open markdown documents, code files, and more. The AI assistant sidebar is available here too.

agentWelcome.title: Start Your First Session
agentWelcome.body: Create an AI coding session. Describe what you want to build, and the agent will help you.

attachFiles.title: Attach Files & Images
attachFiles.body: Drag and drop files or paste images directly into the chat. You can also use @ to mention files from your project.

contextIndicator.title: Context Window
contextIndicator.body: Shows how much of the AI context window is used. Includes files, conversation history, and tools.

diffKeepAll.title: Keep All Changes
diffKeepAll.body: Accept all pending AI changes throughout the document.

diffRevertAll.title: Revert All Changes
diffRevertAll.body: Reject all pending AI changes and restore the original document.

documentSessionControl.title: AI Sessions for This Document
documentSessionControl.body: Jump straight back into the last session on this document, or use the arrow to pick another session or start a new one.

fileTreeFilter.title: Filter Your File Tree
fileTreeFilter.body: Show only markdown files, uncommitted git changes, or files the AI has read or written in this session.

fileTreeQuickOpen.title: Quick Open Files
fileTreeQuickOpen.body: Search for any file in your project by name. Recently opened files appear at the top.

filesScope.title: File Scope Modes
filesScope.body: Control which files are shown. View AI edits from this session, only uncommitted changes, or all files in the workspace. In workstreams, filter by individual session or see all sessions combined.

gitCommitMode.title: Commit Modes
gitCommitMode.body: Choose how to commit your changes. Manual lets you write your own message. Smart uses AI to analyze changes and propose a commit message.

layoutControls.title: Session Layout Modes
layoutControls.body:
View your AI session and files edited together:

**Files**: Show only the file editor tabs. Available when you open an edited file in an AI Session.

**Split**: Show both transcript and editor stacked vertically. Drag the divider to adjust.

**Agent**: Show only the conversation transcript.

modelPicker.title: Select AI Model
modelPicker.body: Choose which AI model to use. Different models have different capabilities and speeds.

planModeToggle.title: Plan vs Agent Mode
planModeToggle.body: Toggle between Plan and Agent modes. Plan mode creates structured plans before the AI writes code. Agent mode executes changes directly.

prReviewMode.title: GitHub
prReviewMode.body: Work this project's GitHub without leaving the app: browse pull requests and issues, read diffs and conversation, and hand either to an agent.

sessionKanban.title: Kanban Board
sessionKanban.body: Switch to a kanban board view of your sessions organized by phase: Backlog, Planning, Implementing, Validating, and Complete. Drag sessions between columns to update their status.

sessionQuickSearch.title: Search Sessions
sessionQuickSearch.body: Quickly find any AI session by name. Type **@** to search by file edited -- find every session that touched a specific file. Press **Tab** to switch to prompt search and find sessions by what you asked.

tip-action-prompts.title: Save reusable prompts as actions
tip-action-prompts.body: Create **nimbalyst-local/ai-actions.md** to define one-click prompts. They show up in the composer's Actions dropdown -- great for recurring workflows like "review this diff" or "write release notes".

tip-agent-diagram.title: Let the agent draw the diagram
tip-agent-diagram.body: The agent has never drawn a diagram for you. Ask it to sketch an architecture or a flow and it will build the Excalidraw diagram directly through its tools.

tip-animation-discover.title: Animate the part that only makes sense moving
tip-animation-discover.body:
Create an **.anim.json** file to build an explainer that plays: a request crossing a cache, a queue draining, a retry after a timeout.

You write steps, not keyframes, so the agent can author and edit the whole thing as plain JSON.

tip-auto-commit.title: Auto-commit after every AI turn
tip-auto-commit.body: Enable auto-commit in the Claude Code panel and every turn ends with a checkpoint commit. Easy to revert, hard to lose work to a runaway agent.

tip-canvas-discover.title: Lay your real files out on one board
tip-canvas-discover.body:
A **.canvas** board holds cards that mount the actual editor for the file they point at -- the mockup renders, the spreadsheet shows real numbers, the document is editable in place.

Describe the board you want and the agent arranges it, wired with edges.
tip-canvas-discover.action: Ask the agent for a board

tip-claude-md.title: Set standing instructions in CLAUDE.md
tip-claude-md.body: Drop a **CLAUDE.md** at the workspace root with your coding conventions, preferred tools, and tone. Every session loads it automatically -- you only have to write it once.

tip-content-search.title: Cmd+Shift+F searches inside files
tip-content-search.body: Hit **Cmd+Shift+F** for cross-file regex search across the workspace. Results group by file with one-click jump-to-line.

tip-datamodel-discover.title: Design schemas visually with DataModelLM
tip-datamodel-discover.body: A **.datamodel** file is a Prisma-style schema with a live ER diagram. The agent can edit it like any source file, and you get the diagram for free.

tip-doc-history.title: Cmd+Y to scrub document history
tip-doc-history.body: Every save snapshots the file. **Cmd+Y** opens the history dialog with diffs against any earlier version -- click to restore. Hidden safety net for big edits.

tip-document-shared.title: Share documents with one link
tip-document-shared.body: Right-click a file and pick **Share** to publish an end-to-end-encrypted link. Recipients open it in a browser -- no Nimbalyst account needed.

tip-excalidraw-discover.title: Sketch architecture in Excalidraw
tip-excalidraw-discover.body: Create a **.excalidraw** file to draw boxes, arrows, and freeform diagrams. The agent can read and modify those drawings via tools -- great for system architecture and flow sketches.

tip-files-agent-context.title: The agent understands your open file
tip-files-agent-context.body: Open a file, then ask the agent to **explain, revise, or extend it**. The active file is included as context automatically.

tip-files-visual-editors.title: Preview mockups and diagrams instantly
tip-files-visual-editors.body: Files like **.mockup.html**, **.excalidraw**, and **.mindmap** open in visual editors. Ask the agent to create one and it renders live as it writes.

tip-keyboard-shortcuts.title: Learn the shortcuts that matter
tip-keyboard-shortcuts.body: You have used the app for a while, but have not triggered any tracked keyboard shortcuts yet. The shortcuts dialog is a fast way to find the ones you will actually use.

tip-lightning-interrupt.title: Lightning button stops a runaway
tip-lightning-interrupt.body: If the agent is heading the wrong way, hit the **lightning bolt** next to the composer to interrupt it. Type a redirect into the composer and it resumes from there -- no need to wait the turn out.

tip-mobile-keep-awake.title: Keep your computer awake for mobile prompts
tip-mobile-keep-awake.body: Your computer going to sleep will disconnect mobile sync. Enable keep-awake while plugged in to prevent this.

tip-mobile-paired.title: Drive sessions from your phone
tip-mobile-paired.body: Pair the iOS app and prompt your desktop agents from anywhere. The desktop runs the heavy work; you steer it from the couch or the road.

tip-mockup-discover.title: Plan UI in a .mockup.html file
tip-mockup-discover.body: Files ending in **.mockup.html** render as live, annotatable wireframes alongside source. Ask the agent to "create a mockup for X" to get a starting point you can edit visually.

tip-nimbalyst-coach.title: Find out what you are missing
tip-nimbalyst-coach.body: Your agent can read this project and your recent sessions and tell you what would make them go better -- **extensions** that match your files, features you have not touched, and **instructions** worth adding so every future session starts smarter.

tip-quick-open.title: Cmd+O fuzzy-opens any file
tip-quick-open.body: Skip the file tree. **Cmd+O** opens a fuzzy finder over every file in the workspace -- type a fragment of the path and hit enter.

tip-session-cleanup.title: Let your agent tidy the Sessions board
tip-session-cleanup.body: Your Sessions board is filling up. Your agent can **clean it up** -- fixing each session's phase, marking finished work **complete**, and flagging old sessions to archive.

tip-session-launch-shortcut.title: Start sessions without losing your place
tip-session-launch-shortcut.body: Press **Cmd+Shift+N** anywhere in Nimbalyst to open the session launcher. Submit your prompt and the session starts in the background, so you stay right where you are.

tip-session-shared.title: Share a session, not a screenshot
tip-session-shared.body: Sessions can be published as **end-to-end-encrypted links** with 1, 7, or 30 day expiry. Use the share button on a session to send the full transcript to a teammate.

tip-spreadsheet-discover.title: CSV files open as spreadsheets
tip-spreadsheet-discover.body: Drop a **.csv** in the workspace and it opens with sorting, formulas, and AI tooling -- no need to flip to source view to make edits.

tip-teams-multiplayer.title: Make this workspace multiplayer
tip-teams-multiplayer.body: With **Teams**, your docs, mockups, diagrams, and trackers can be shared. Teammates edit the same files live or asynch, and each teammate's local agent works on those same shared artifacts. Promote any local file to shared in a click or create a new shared file. See how Teams works https://nimbalyst.com/teams

tip-theme-explore.title: Try a different theme
tip-theme-explore.body: You have been back a few times without changing the look of the app. **Themes** are already built in, and the settings panel shows the full set at once.

tip-tracker-mode.title: Track work alongside your sessions
tip-tracker-mode.body: You have been using AI sessions heavily, but **Tracker Mode** gives you a durable place to manage bugs, tasks, and decisions across those sessions.

tip-wakeup.title: Let the agent page itself later
tip-wakeup.body: Ask the agent to **schedule a wakeup** ("check the build in 5 minutes", "poll the PR every 30s") and it self-resumes -- no need to babysit a long-running task.

tip-worktree-session.title: Isolate risky work in a worktree
tip-worktree-session.body: You are deep into agent sessions on a git repo, but have not created a **worktree session** yet. Worktrees give experiments their own branch and working directory without disturbing the main checkout.

rosetta.title: Running via Rosetta Translation
rosetta.description: You're running the Intel (x64) build on an Apple Silicon Mac. Download the native Apple Silicon build for significantly better performance.

discord.title: Join the Community
discord.description: Get faster help, share feedback with the team, and stay up to date on new releases.

extensionIntro.title: Build with Extensions
extensionIntro.description: Extensions add custom editors, AI tools, commands, panels, and more. Nimbalyst loads your extension live while you develop.

capabilities.editors: Custom editors for any file type, with native look and feel
capabilities.panels: Side panels and workspace views for dashboards and live status
capabilities.aiTools: AI tools that Claude can use while working in your project
capabilities.devLoop: In-app dev loop — build, install, and reload without leaving Nimbalyst

extensionIntro.agentHint: Describe what you want to the agent, and it will scaffold, build, and install the extension for you.

databaseMaintenance.readyRollback: Restart Nimbalyst to reopen the database after rollback. The SQLite copy has been retained.
databaseMaintenance.readyMigration: Nimbalyst will reopen and verify the database on the next startup. The pre-migration copy has been retained.
databaseMaintenance.pausedRollback: The database is paused while the pre-migration copy is restored. Keep Nimbalyst open until this step finishes.
databaseMaintenance.pausedMigration: The database is paused while the final changes are copied. Keep Nimbalyst open until this step finishes.

results.cancelHint: Cancelling drops the answers already in. Closing keeps them.

wakeEnded.closed: This request is closed. The session has been woken with what came in.
wakeEnded.expired: This request is expired. The session has been woken with what came in.
wakeEnded.cancelled: This request is cancelled. The session has been woken with what came in.

results.wakeQuorum: Quorum is in, so the session has been woken with these answers.
results.wakeWaiting: The session wakes when {{required}} of {{total}} have answered, when you close this request, or when you nudge someone. Nothing has been sent to it yet.
results.answersAnonymous: answers stay anonymous on this request
results.anonymousOutstanding: Answers on this request are anonymous, so who is still outstanding stays hidden here too — naming them would identify the answers already in. Nudging goes to everyone who has not answered.
results.anonymousNote: You asked for this one hidden until answered, so the tally is anonymous — for you as well, and it stays that way after everyone has answered.
results.observerNote: You are not the author of this request, so closing and nudging are not yours to do here.
results.offlineNote: Closing and nudging are not available in this session yet.

ranked.contested: Contested — {{top}} of {{total}} put it near the top, {{bottom}} near the bottom

otherProject.tracker: Open the project that owns this tracker item to view it.

artifacts.selectWorkstream: Select a workstream in this project to open this tracker item.

preview.notOnMachine: This file is not on this machine, so there is nothing to preview.

tab.invalid: This tab does not point at a feedback request any more.

errors.noTeam: This workspace has no team to send the request to.
errors.noWorkspace: This session has no workspace to send from.
errors.folderNotCreated: The {{folder}} folder could not be created.
errors.questionNotSent: The question could not be sent.
errors.answersNotSent: Your answers could not be sent.
errors.nudgeNotSent: The nudge could not be sent.
errors.notCancelled: The request could not be cancelled.
errors.notClosed: The request could not be closed.
errors.sessionNotPublishable: A session cannot be published, so a teammate cannot be asked to review one.
errors.documentNotShared: That document is not in your team files, so it cannot be shared from here.
errors.kindNotPublishable: Nimbalyst cannot publish this {{kind}} for you yet. Share it with your team first, then send the request.
errors.trackerPersonal: This tracker item is still personal because its tracker type is personal-scoped. Change the tracker type sharing policy, then retry.
